decisions.reason: Removing Big Blocks does not change whether the flat secondary-sale royalty is enforced or its amount.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter while preserving Small Block accounting.
The collection remains an unlimited-mint NFT ebook regardless of the removal of Big Blocks.
The generic transfer rules for active and expired prize tickets remain valid for the continuing Small Block tickets.
The existing message-195 MODIFY removes big_block_prize_copy and rewrites all affected composite FAQ copy to describe only the remaining Small Block mechanism.
The Small Block mechanism remains active, and its existing message-195 MODIFY already records the new $5-per-mint pool allocation.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes both Big Block ticket-issuance attributes while retaining Small Block issuance.
Removing Big Blocks does not alter the NFT mint number's identity, lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior as a referral code.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows VRF selection and its scope to the remaining Small Block draw.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows no-referral ticket allocation to Small Block tickets.
Automatic direct wallet delivery remains valid for the continuing Small Block prizes and is not changed by removal of Big Blocks.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $5 founder share, $5 commission share, $5 Small Block pool share, and removal of Big Block from active pool destinations.
